decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 2 - The extension hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwelling known as 3A Mandeville Road, Isleworth.
Condition : 3 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in any wall of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the attached outbuilding hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Retrospective application for the retention of an attached outbuilding with a basement and its continued use as a residential living area ancillary to the main house
